item.title: 10 Free Browser Games That are Actually Fun to Play
item.description: If you do your research, though, you’ll find a treasure trove of easily-accessible gems — like a solo dev’s reworked Diablo village where you watch your party auto-battle its way through catacombs, or an idle game where managing catnip supply chains spirals into deep-space civilization management. Deduction mysteries, language-learning puzzles, and dungeon crawlers usually come with a price tag and a download bar. Tragically for your productivity and spare time, these ten do not.

item.title: Calvin and Hobbes' Final Strip is Still the Perfect Goodbye
item.description: On November 18, 1985, the very first comic strip of Calvin and Hobbes appeared in newspapers. “So long, pop! I’m off to check my tiger trap!” Calvin, wearing a safari helmet, said to his dad in the first panel. Calvin went on to explain that he rigged the trap with a tuna fish sandwich, something a tiger cannot resist. In the last panel, Hobbes is seen for the first time, hanging upside down in a tree, eating the sandwich.

item.title: 10 Essential NES Games Still Missing From Switch Online
item.description: The Nintendo Entertainment System is credited with rescuing a flailing industry back in the late ‘80s and early ‘90s. Over the years, hundreds of amazing games launched for the console, and many of the best and most memorable of them are now available to play on Nintendo Switch Online . However, dozens of other fantastic titles still haven’t reached the service, and that needs to change. Out of those dozens remaining, here are 10 NES games that still need to come to Switch Online as soon as possible.

item.title: Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season start time
item.description: The Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season, " Treasure Hunters ," is upon us, with Chapter 7 Season 4 coming to a close on Nov. 1 . Video games are so out. The new "in" thing? Pirates. Pirates are so in. As usual, Season 4 will end and the game will have a lengthy maintenance period. After maintenance is over, you'll be able to jump into the mini season as soon as you log in.

item.title: The 10 Best Star Trek: The Next Generation Episodes, Ranked
item.description: One of the great things about Star Trek: The Next Generation is that you never quite knew what kind of adventure you were going to get. One week, the Enterprise might be facing an enemy capable of destroying the Federation. The next, Captain Picard could be living an entire lifetime on an alien planet. And occasionally, Worf would find himself dressed as one of Robin Hood's Merry Men, looking like he'd rather be anywhere else in the galaxy.

item.title: New Pokémon Release Brings Hundreds of New Eeveelutions
item.description: With eight official Eeveelutions, fans of the beloved normal-type Pokémon aren't hurting for options — yet paradoxically, they're also one of the most neglected segments of the fandom. After all, it's been 13 years since Game Freak introduced a new Eevee monster in Pokémon X and Pokémon Y . With 18 standard Pokémon types in the games, that means we haven't seen even half of the possible Eeveelution concepts. Never mind the number of Eeveelutions that would be possible if Pokémon's developers ever started combining Eeveelution types.

item.title: The Witcher 3’s Fairy Tale-Inspired Quests Are Must-Plays for Any RPG Fan
item.description: As a franchise spanning video games, books, and a television series, The Witcher owes everything to 300-year-old fairy tales. The very first book, The Last Wish (which itself is a collection of short stories set in The Witcher universe), has a number of fairy tale references, including "A Grain of Truth" being a twist on Beauty and the Beast , "A Question of Price" bears close resemblance to Cinderella with a celebration at a ball and a knight that can only remove his helmet after midnight, and "The Last Wish" (the short story the collection is named after) is about a genie granting three wishes, a la Aladdin and the Wonderful Lamp .

item.title: The Worst GTA Game Is One Rockstar Could Never Make Today
item.description: GTA Advance is an odd game. It's terrible in some ways, yet also not as bad as its reputation suggests. It's also an essential part of Rockstar history. This was Rockstar at a stage of uncertainty. The essence of the Grand Theft Auto franchise was still in flux, and the studio had yet to firmly decide on what, exactly, made a GTA game . GTA Advance has its strong points, but the most important thing about it is how it gave Rockstar (via developer Digital Eclipse) a chance to see where the series could fall short. It's a necessary bad game that paved the way for better ones — and the kind of essential failure the games industry can't tolerate anymore.

item.title: Activision Apologizes for 'Modern Warfare 4' Footage After Backlash
item.description: Activision has apologized after including real footage of a deadly 2022 incident in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , confirming that the footage will be completely removed in a forthcoming update following backlash from victims' families. The latest Call of Duty game included snippets of footage from the Seoul Halloween crowd crush, during which more than 150 people were killed in the Itaewon neighborhood of Seoul, South Korea.
